_doc: F5: detect a struggling consumer. Multiple valid tool paths — list-queues exposes the slowSubscriber flag, get-queue-metrics gives backlog depth, list-clients/get-client-details can also surface it. Accept any; assert the F5 queue surfaces in the answer. forbidden_substrings catches refusals from missing fixtures (e.g. 'queue doesn't exist') — without these the assertion would PASS on an echo-the-name refusal because $F5_QUEUE is mentioned in both.
prompt: Are any consumers on $BROKER struggling to keep up right now?
